answer: In PoA, each evaluator’s service score propagates through a reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust matrix, while exponential temporal decay halves reputation at a fixed interval. Honest agents therefore require sustained, mutually corroborated service to retain centrality. A freshly spawned sybil, even in a garden of colluding identities linked as a vine or polished pearl, begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality; lacking trusted inbound mass, it cannot pass consensus.
